title: Hoonymode
wikitext: Hoonymode is a type of duel mode similar to regular duel, but designed to avoid spawn fragging and to reward positional play. It can also be used as a teaching tool to study spawn routines. Type /hoonymode to enable hoonymode on [[KTX]] [[servers]]. == Hoonymode rules == Hoonymode is like /1on1 with the following differences: * There is a countdown and respawn between each frag (like fraglimit 1) ** On respawn, players have 100 health, no armor, no weapons. * First player to X number of frags wins (on 12 rounds, X = 6) * Victory must be achieved by a difference of 2 or more frags ** Rounds go on indefinitely until a difference of 2 is achieved (tiebreaker, like in tennis) * So, for example: ** 6-0 first player wins ** 6-5 the game continues ** 7-5 first player wins ** 6-4 first player wins * Spawn points: ** First spawn is like in /1on1 ** Second spawns are the same as first, but reversed (you will get opponent's first spawn, and he will get yours) ** Third spawns are like in /1on1 ** Fourth spawns are the same as second, but reversed ** And so on. Spawns will switch in each round. * During countdown between frags it will announce "New spawns" or "Switch spawns" accordingly, and the spawn location. If it's a potential final round, it will print "Set point". In warmup, use /pickspawn to select the nearest spawn, repeat the command to select random spawns. == Server requirements == Hoonymode is available in KTX versions 1.37 and above. Server admins must add 128 to k_allowed_free_modes in their .cfg in order to support hoonymode. {{terminology}} [[Category:Game modes]]
